Roasted sweet potato, about 150 g at roughly 90 to 120 kcal per 100 g, comes to about 160 kcal. The fruit (strawberries about 130 g, raspberries about 15 g, blackberries about 20 g) is about 165 g and roughly 60 kcal. That gives about 315 g in total. Allowing for some oil on the potatoes, the estimate is about 230 kcal.
